sar.narrative: This report concerns suspected fraud following an undocumented coordinated pattern on card C07297-K1 held by customer C07297 (internal case AC-HHG-006, opened 2016-11-22). On 2016-11-21 the card was used for 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,906.07: on 2016-11-21 $478.95 online in billing region 264.0; on 2016-11-21 $456.96 online in billing region 476.0; on 2016-11-21 $488.04 online in billing region 476.0; on 2016-11-21 $482.12 online in billing region 264.0. All four purchases were online, each between $450 and $499.99, placed within 30 minutes from 2 device profiles marked New for the account, on a card that had made only 197 transactions before, almost all in person. Amounts sit just under a $500 authorisation threshold, and 12 other cards show the identical shape within 30 days, which analysts previously confirmed as fraud in five closed cases. The cardholder reported that they did not make the purchase and still hold the card. The activity is inconsistent with the cardholder's history (prior median purchase $62.93). No prior report has been filed on this customer. OFAC SDN screening of the customer identifier: no match (anonymised identifiers; screening result recorded from the sdn.csv lookup in the live run). Recommended actions: a block and reissue of the card, not yet done and awaiting team-lead approval, internal case opened, case escalated to an analyst.

stop_reason: Policy §6 test 1: fraud probability 0.90 is at or above 0.85 with 2 independent evidence families (customer, history); no request could change the action set, so the initial recommendation is final.
